description: The 07:00 Brief for one day: title, subtitle, hero line, market regime, what matters and why, the take, the signal being watched, upcoming catalysts, risks and what to watch, with that morning's Market Map, Big Picture and Three Minute Brief notes when they were published. Without a date it is the latest brief; with date (YYYY-MM-DD) it is the brief published that day.
name: get_morning_brief
title: Get morning brief
